confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of tourist-area pricing in Luang Prabang, not live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and vary by season, and July is green season, when demand and rates are usually lower. Cocktail and wine are bounded using the local beer relationship (roughly 3x and 3.7x beer). The FX observation comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange rates overview page, not from opening the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with tourist-oriented northern Thailand (Chiang Mai) and other Lao tourist towns. Food and drinks are generally cheaper than Chiang Mai, but Luang Prabang's heritage-tourism pricing lifts cafes, bars and mid-range restaurants above rest-of-Laos levels. Accommodation is benchmarked to guesthouse and boutique-hotel ranges in comparable Southeast Asian heritage towns, adjusted for the July shoulder period.
